scripts.//: generate runs first everywhere, so src/pages-data.ts can never drift from webflow-pages/
scripts.build: npm install && node generate-data.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && webflow extension bundle
scripts.dev: npm install && node generate-data.mjs && concurrently -r "webflow extension serve" "tsc -p tsconfig.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput"
